views.rationale: Net sales rose 8% ($28.5 billion) in FY2022 versus 2021
Revenues increased $1.9 billion for the nine months ended Sep 30 2022 versus 2021
Total upstream earnings jumped to $24.8 billion in Q3 2022 from $10.7 billion a year earlier
Sales grew 3.3% year‑to‑date with a 7.9% operational increase, indicating modest revenue momentum into the next quarter
Technology, Media & Telecommunications loans account for 17% of total loans and 20% of commitments, highlighting a concentration risk
Microsoft's operating income increased by 10.2% of revenue in the three months ended October 30, 2022.
Net income attributable to NEE increased by $1,249 million for the three months ended September 30, 2022.
Gross profit margin increased to 55.1% of revenue in the nine months ended October 31, 2022.
